title: ModelAI ESWA End-to-End Reproducibility Archive
description: End-to-end reproducibility package v1.1.1 for “Auditable Expert State-Machine Representations for Early Sepsis Prediction.” The pipeline reconstructs all analysis intermediates directly from the public PhysioNet/CinC 2019 raw PSV files, uses portable command-line paths, verifies canonical arrays before training, and reproduces model fitting, calibration, utility, bootstrap, cross-site, and repeated-split analyses.
notes: Archive the exact frozen v1.1.1 release. Raw PhysioNet source data are not redistributed.
